# Personal Research Graph / 个人知识库

> A macOS application combining PubMed and AI to build a personalized research knowledge base and help users quickly understand a field's recent research landscape, with claim-level keyword retrieval, traceable sources, research direction organization, and editable learning notes.

Names: Personal Research Graph; Personal Knowledge Builder; 个人知识库.
Repository role: public Beta distribution only; source code is not published here.
Canonical repository: https://github.com/echoechofu/research-graph-beta
Downloads: https://github.com/echoechofu/research-graph-beta/releases/latest
Current documented release: 0.3.0-beta.3, build 3003.
Platform: Apple Silicon macOS. Package declares macOS 14+; tested on macOS 15.6.1; physical macOS 14 validation pending.

## Documentation

- [中文介绍](https://github.com/echoechofu/research-graph-beta/blob/main/README.md): 功能、安装、数据流与当前边界。
- [English overview](https://github.com/echoechofu/research-graph-beta/blob/main/README.en.md): Capabilities, installation, data flow, and current limitations.
- [Release history](https://github.com/echoechofu/research-graph-beta/releases): Installers and release notes.
- [Journal data notice](https://github.com/echoechofu/research-graph-beta/blob/main/data/jcr/README.md): Supported JCR2025 CSV structure, hitfyd/ShowJCR acknowledgment, import steps, and rights notice. This repository does not mirror the dataset.

## Available capabilities

- User-reviewed research scope and PubMed query planning.
- Abstract-first extraction of claims linked to source papers and PMIDs.
- Local Chinese/English keyword search over existing claims, with phrases and filters; no LLM needed for retrieval.
- LLM-assisted organization by human, animal, and cell/ex vivo research, then research direction and question.
- Explicitly saved, freely editable plain-text learning notes with independent original-source snapshots.
- UTF-8 TXT note export including numbered references, claim snapshots, and PubMed links; notes included in knowledge-base JSON export.
- User-initiated literature updates, PMID deduplication, checkpoints, and result reuse.
- Independent UI and knowledge-base language settings for Chinese and English.
- Local persistent data; external PubMed and user-configured OpenAI-compatible model requests for relevant operations.
- User-confirmed native Beta updates using Sparkle and Ed25519 verification.

## Current boundaries

No vector semantic retrieval, open-ended knowledge-base chat, unattended scheduled monitoring, full-text analysis pipeline, automatic scientific truth adjudication, or combined evidence score is currently advertised. PubMed is the current literature source. JCR data and model credits are not bundled. A journal CSV setup guide is available; users supply data they are entitled to use. Initial manual macOS approval may be required because the app is ad-hoc signed and not notarized. AI outputs require source checking.

## 中文摘要

个人知识库基于 PubMed，结合 AI，围绕用户的研究主题、对象和时间范围定制知识库，自动化查找文献、分析摘要和组织方向，帮助用户快速了解一个领域近期都在研究什么。研究范围由用户确认，后续更新由用户发起。论文摘要中的研究发现组织为可追溯的 Claim。当前检索采用本地关键词匹配；AI 可按人体、动物、细胞／离体研究及研究方向整理结果。用户主动保存后形成可编辑学习笔记，并可连同编号参考文献和原始 Claim 快照导出。数据保存在本机，AI 操作使用用户配置的外部模型服务。该仓库只发布 macOS Beta 安装包与更新信息，不发布源码。
